source_title: ATTACK SHARK Unveils X60 Gaming Headset, Combining Precision Audio, All-Day Comfort, and an RGB Wireless Charging Dock
source_excerpt:
New flagship headset brings together high-fidelity acoustics, ergonomic engineering, low-latency wireless connectivity, and desktop expansion features in a single gaming audio solution
NEW YORK , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- High-performance gaming peripheral brand ATTACK SHARK is set to introduce the X60 Gaming Headset , its latest premium audio offering built to meet the demands of competitive gamers and multi-device users. The headset combines advanced acoustic engineering, ergonomic comfort, low-latency wireless performance, and an RGB-enabled charging dock with integrated hub functionality. It is a complete desktop audio solution built for FPS gaming, entertainment, and extended daily use.
The X60 features a 53mm dynamic driver with a PEN nano-polymer diaphragm, a material widely used in professional audio equipment for its ability to reduce distortion and improve clarity. Combined with a large independent acoustic chamber and airflow-balancing technology, the design delivers precise sound reproduction with clear layering and accurate positional cues, helping players react faster in competitive gameplay. Premium Audio Quality â Experience rich, immersive sound with crisp footsteps, detailed in-game effects, and enhanced audio depth
Beyond the hardware, ATTACK SHARK has refined the listening experience through professional acoustic tuning. Developed with input from audio engineers with over 20 years of experience, the X60 delivers a balanced sound profile that combines detailed reproduction, natural vocal presentation, and the impact required for immersive gameplay. The result is a versatile audio experience suited to competitive gaming, music, and everyday entertainment.
To complement its audio performance, the X60 also places strong emphasis on voice communication during gameplay. The headset features a proprietary AI audio-processing chip designed to enhance microphone noise reduction across multiple channels. Paired with a detachable 360Â° high-sensitivity microphone and AI voice-enhancement algorithms, the system helps capture speech clearly while reducing unwanted background noise, ensuring reliable team communication even in noisy environments.
Users can further refine their experience through the companion software, which offers 7.1 virtual surround sound, spatial audio settings, preset EQ profiles, and customizable equalizer controls. Personalized audio settings can be saved and switched easily, allowing the X60 to adapt to different games, content, and listening preferences.
Engineered for Desktop Integration, Connectivity, and Comfort
One of the X60's defining features is its RGB touch-enabled wireless charging dock, designed to extend the headset beyond a standalone audio device. It supports convenient drop-and-charge functionality while minimizing charging heat, keeping the headset powered and ready for use. It also doubles as a desktop expansion hub with integrated USB and Type-C ports, helping address the growing demand for connectivity across modern gaming setups. Combined with customizable RGB lighting effects, the dock brings together charging, connectivity, and desktop aesthetics in a single solution.
The X60 further enhances everyday versatility with ATTACK SHARK's upgraded proprietary 2.4GHz wireless technology, engineered for low-latency performance and stable connections. Four connection modes, including 2.4GHz Type-C, 2.4GHz USB-A, Bluetooth 6.0, and wired USB-A, provide broad compatibility across PCs, laptops, smartphones, tablets, PS4, PS5, Switch, Xbox, and other mainstream gaming platforms. A built-in 1000mAh battery supports extended playtime and allows gaming while charging, while physical slide controls enable quick and intuitive switching between connection modes and key functions.
Comfort remains a central part of the design. A reinforced headband frame and aluminum alloy supports provide durability without compromising flexibility, while the 3D adjustment system allows the earcups to rotate up to 90Â° horizontally, tilt freely up to 37.5Â°, and adapt to different head sizes through three-level headband adjustment. Combined with breathable microfiber ear cushions and a memory foam headband, the design delivers a secure, pressure-free fit for extended gaming sessions.
The ATTACK SHARK X60 Gaming Headset will be available starting from November 4, 2026.
For more information, visit https://attackshark.com/ or connect with the brand on social media and Discord .
